tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue: primary button fill, pay amount, active filter chip, focus border, logo tile. White text on it is 3.23:1 — below 4.5:1 for 16px button labels; kept exact from the source, use bold ≥19px or `primary-press` where legibility matters.

tokens.name: primary-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `primary` buttons; text colour of secondary/ghost buttons, info badges and the active nav item. 4.14:1 on white and 3.65:1 on `primary-soft` — below 4.5:1 for small text (source value kept).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Accent ground: secondary button fill, info badge and notice, avatar, plan bar, benefit icon tile, 3px focus halo around inputs.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen, the dock fade and the success screen.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card, sheet, search field, filter chip, round back button and bottom-nav surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Main text on `bg` (13.8:1) and `card`; also the fill of the dark tip bubble.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — employer name, subtitles, hints, inactive nav labels — on `bg` (4.55:1) and `card` (4.83:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: input and filter-chip borders, nav top border, dividers between info rows.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Soft red for ⚡ Gấp badges, errors and the 'Rút đơn' / 'Đóng tin' text buttons. On `danger-soft` it is 2.85:1 and on white 3.26:1 — below 4.5:1 for 12–15px text (source value kept); body-length error copy uses `danger-ink`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the urgent badge and the error notice.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error notice text on `danger-soft` (6.03:1). Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success green: 'Được nhận' badge, the success tick, ✓ bullets in pricing. On `success-soft` 2.72:1 — below 4.5:1 for badge text (source value kept); always pair with a word or ✓, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the success badge and the success-screen tick disc.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Info notice and plan-bar text on `primary-soft` (6.42:1). Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the warning notice (e.g. location denied).

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Warning notice text on `warn-soft` (5.52:1). Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: chip-bg
tokens.usage: Grey ground of meta chips (📅 📍 👥) and the grey badge ('Đã đóng', 'Gói hiện tại'). Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Chip text (6.86:1 on `chip-bg`), field labels, landing lead and FAQ answers. Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: input-bg
tokens.usage: Resting fill of inputs, selects and textareas (turns `card` on focus). Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Track of an off switch. Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Grab handle at the top of a bottom sheet. Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled buttons ('Đã đủ người'). Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Label of disabled buttons on `disabled-bg` (2.05:1 — disabled controls are exempt, but the label must still say why, e.g. 'Đã đủ người').

tokens.name: tip-link
tokens.usage: Dismiss link inside the dark tip bubble, on `text` (10.1:1). Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind bottom sheets. Literal in styles.css, lifted into a token.
